verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a public Web API at a dedicated docs endpoint, and its pricing page lists an API alongside the audit log. That is the product's own programmatic interface, but the evidence never says which operations it exposes. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt at the candidate paths, which limits agent-friendly consumption. missing for 10: evidence of what the API can drive (sessions, devices, users, scripts), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
